title: Services
intro: Here’s an overview of the work we do, from quick tune-ups to full restorations.
note: Every bike is different, so get in touch for a free quote or to book a slot.

services.title: Basic Service
services.description: Brake and gear adjustment, safety check, tyre pressure and quick tune — ideal between major services.

services.title: Full Overhaul
services.description: Strip, clean, replace bearings and consumables as needed, reassemble and test ride.

services.title: Restoration & Sourcing
services.description: We restore period bikes and can source hard-to-find parts for authentic restorations.
